items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: her name is Nyesha Walton and uh, that's a combination of Naima, which was John Coltran's wife

ctx.x: Uh, all the pieces on his uh, Giant Steps presentation. Um, Black Sonny, Giant Steps, Countdown, uh, Naima – that, that, that recording. That's what he was referring to. And so, he said he heard, he wanted me to hear it because I hadn't heard it, didn't remember it.
You weren't involved in that recording, were you?
